# Streets

Road decals ported from RMC-14 with their ids kept (`RMCDecalRoad*`): road edges, stop marks and tyre marks. Content
only, placed by mappers. The rest of the module (street furniture, road tiles, Hybrisa decals and the port tool that
generates `road.yml`) lives on the `planetspoi` branch.
